name: Assert
description: Runtime invariant. Pass-through when the condition (NCalc expression) is truthy; throws a structured error and halts the rule when falsy. Use for sanity checks like 'amount must be positive' or 'pax count must equal segment count'.

params.name: condition
params.description: NCalc expression. Truthy = pass-through. Variables resolve from upstream value, $ctx, $.request, and any open iteration frames.

params.name: errorCode
params.description: Stable code surfaced in the trace when the assert fails (defaults to ASSERT_FAILED).

params.name: errorMessage
params.description: Human-readable message included in the error envelope. Falls back to the condition source when omitted.
